extraction_text: The Employer is obligated to provide full training to all affected employees of new equipment, forms, responsibilities and procedures as soon as they are implemented in any office.

The Employer will provide the Union with written notice of introduction into the workplace of new, office-wide technology. Employer, in its discretion, may seek employee input in the roll-out or implementation of such office-wide technology. This provision shall not apply to new office equipment.

## 12.5 Procedures and Technology

## (A) Training in Changed Office Procedures

The Employer is obligated to provide full training to all affected employees of new equipment, forms, responsibilities and procedures as soon as they are implemented in any office.
